items.title: ASTS Retail Traders Turn Bullish After SpaceX Earnings, Call Starlink’s Carrier War ‘Best Strategic Gift’ From Elon Musk
items.summary: AT&T and Verizon anchor ASTS’ U.S. strategy, while its broader network includes nearly 60 carrier partners covering more than 3 billion subscribers.

items.title: T, VZ, TMUS Stocks Drop After-Hours — SpaceX Targets Wireless Giants As COO Gwynne Shotwell Sees Room To Win ‘Their Customers’
items.summary: Traditional U.S. wireless carriers are bracing for aggressive competition as SpaceX plans to expand beyond satellite coverage to build a full-scale terrestrial mobile network.

items.title: SpaceX Sends Telecom Providers a Shot Across the Bow
items.summary: SpaceX is coming for large U.S. telecom providers.  During the company’s first earnings call, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell referenced the revenue that AT&T, Verizon Communications and T-Mobile US pull in, and said Starlink would take aim at their subscribers.  “I anticipate us to be able to acquire quite a few of their customers because I think our service will be better,” Shotwell said.

items.title: Primoris Services (PRIM) Reports Q2 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Primoris Services (PRIM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +22.86% and -0.51%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Wireless Stocks Turn Lower on SpaceX Mobile Plans
items.summary: Shares of T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon Communications dipped late Tuesday after SpaceX said it planned to launch a mobile offering in 2027.  SpaceX can use its Starlink space-based broadband product to offer service.  Shares of T-Mobile were off 1.8% in after-hours trading.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile vs. First Majestic Silver: Which Industrials Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: One burns $1.1B in cash annually while the other generates $351.6M, a stark divide in financial health that reshapes the growth-vs.-stability debate.

items.title: TMUS Raises Cash Flow Outlook After Another Strong Earnings Quarter
items.summary: TMUS lifts its free cash flow outlook after strong subscriber growth, rising service revenue and expanding broadband momentum strengthen quarterly results.

items.title: Should Investors Buy TMUS or Wait for Better Risk-Reward Ahead?
items.summary: T-Mobile US continues adding subscribers and expanding broadband, but can strong growth keep justifying its premium valuation amid intense wireless competition?
